chapter_title: Concerning Four Hunters of Light and Four of Darkn

fills.notes: After the descent the First Man ‘catches’ the enmity; correspondentially the hunter’s first act is constriction/ligation of the hostile will so it can be handled by the net and sons (powers).
A net is ‘cast/spread’ over a domain; the next clause already has ‘out over’.
The net over the ‘children of Darkness’ aims at a collective capture (bringing scattered powers into one hold).
Hunting-by-net over a sea commonly yields a ‘shoal/school’ image; correspondentially: many falsities/evils herded into a single constraint.
In the oldest register ‘net’ = the ordering faculty by which powers are arranged; thus ‘mind’ (the interior form that holds powers in a pattern) plus ‘his powers’.
The light-image functions as a net by surrounding/containing the mixed cosmos so the light within it can be taken ‘as established in them’.
The syntax demands transition to the next item in the hunter-correspondence list (ship/sea/net).
‘Sea = universe’ is then specified by its ‘regions’/spaces within which the hunted lights are lodged.
The hunted things are ‘taken prisoner’ and then ‘to this likeness’; they are made manifest by means of the image. This keeps the correspondential function: manifestation/drawing-out by form.
The fourth hunter is not a person but a cosmological function: the universal counsel that orders and finally gathers life into the Last Statue.
‘Circuit of the worlds’ is the natural container-image for a universal counsel ‘living in the circuit’.
The counsel ‘travels in the five elements’; the next clause explicitly names fire, so the missing genitive naturally identifies the elemental domain.
The fire burns ‘all the buildings of this universe’; oldest-layer register avoids moralizing and keeps the structural cosmogonic object.
The entangling occurs ‘at the beginning of the worlds’; the lacuna resumes that temporal anchor before ‘through all his powers’.
The ‘evil counsel’ is placed in a middle region from which it can ‘draw up’ from earths to heaven; in this cosmology the aerial/mid-region is the seat of such upward-drawing mechanisms.
The target is ‘the light’ specifically insofar as it is ‘mixed’ in the lower compositions; this matches the earlier ‘light that is in all things’.
Parallelism: ‘hunts… and draws up… from… to…’.
The source is plural ‘the earths’; the preposition phrase needs a universal qualifier before specifying the earths.
A net that ‘draws up from the abyss to the heights’ corresponds to a drawing force (wind/breath) rather than a static object; ‘wind’ fits the mid-region (air) logic and the verb ‘drawn up’.
Completion of the broken word.
Introduces defining clause: ‘lust that walks…’.
Balances the series of hunters on the Darkness-side: lust ‘also’ operates in every fleshly power.
‘Powers of the flesh’ are realized in bodily ‘members’; lust ‘walks’ in them as in instruments.
The function of lust as hunter is to fasten/ensnare living souls into bodies.
The bodies are the constructed receptacles; ‘which are fashioned’ keeps the impersonal, structural register (not moral blame) and fits the fragment ‘which …’.

assessment: Most gaps can be restored at the level of correspondential function (net = enclosing form; sea = domain; ship = conveyance/body; hunting = constriction and drawing-out). Exact wording is less tightly constrained where the Coptic Vorlage could have used several near-synonyms (bind/entangle/enclose; regions/spaces; wind/breath). Paragraphs 9–10 remain the least certain because the damaged clauses likely named specific middle-world mechanisms; restorations there follow the oldest-layer cosmological logic (aerial drawing-force; lust binding souls into fashioned bodies) rather than later moralizing phrasing.
